profiles.notes: The simplest real profile: Windows Notepad. `process` and `class` must match exactly, `title` is a regex.
Cisco Packet Tracer 8.x is Qt: the widget tree is on UIA, and the IOS console lives in the device window. `read` gets the text; `read ocr` reads the pixels when the terminal exposes nothing.
Browser dashboards: match on the title instead of the process, because every tab shares the browser's pid.
